spec.kitLine: Full Charge x8 → Max HP +5% of caster
spec.assertion: chargeCounter(8) emits maxHpFlat (FLAT-resolved, value >> 5) to all allies with a ~5s expiresFrame. Fails under the nearest-wrong hitCount-on-pulls trigger (fire count would approach shots/8) and under targetMaxHpPct/raw-percentage encoding (value would be 5).

A burstCdr effect with seconds=7 exists, and deleting every burstCdr strictly reduces the burstCast count over 180s. Fails under a dropped-line model (counts equal) — this is the kit's only genuinely rotation-moving line.

attackDamagePct=6.65, continuous (no durationShots, no in-fight expiry), on selfAndAdjacent. Fails under atkPct (wrong bucket → different totals) and under target-widening to allies (team total rises, proving the 4th slot is genuinely outside the window).
it.skip — the engine's `formation` gate covers noB1/hasB1 only; there is no row/position axis. Authored as an unconditional passive under the stated assumption that the supporter sits back row.

damageTakenPct is NEGATIVE and ally-targeted (never casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null). Fails under the classic sign/target confusion — the counterfactual that flips it positive and re-points it at the enemy raises team damage, proving the faithful defensive encoding is what's live.

burstCast-keyed (NOT fullBurstEnter — text says 'when using Burst Skill'), continuous caster-scaled maxHpFlat to all allies. Payload is offensively inert; the discriminating content is the trigger identity and that the line is encoded rather than dropped.

it.skip — no SELF-status primitive exists (targetStatus is enemy-only). Ladder approximated by trigger-threshold ordering. Every gated payload is Max HP, so the approximation moves ZERO damage; completeness-only.

casterAtkPct FLAT-resolved (emitted value > 15.07), all allies, expiresFrame ~600 frames past apply, no durationShots. Fails under plain atkPct (emits the literal 15.07 and scales each target's own ATK) and under deletion (team total drops). This is rouge's primary damage contribution.

Encoded as a coin-gated caster-scaled maxHpFlat to all allies; asserted present in the event log AND asserted damage-inert (deleting all Max-HP grants leaves every slug's total byte-identical, per the e3 ally-grant rule).

Same channel/inertness as above. Non-vacuity is established separately: the 30-charge Shield Coin tier must be reachable at least once in 180s, else this branch and the Double-Sword branch would both be untestable.

Same channel/inertness. Also covered by the no-unexpected-stat-channels assertion: rouge may only ever emit casterAtkPct / attackDamagePct / maxHpFlat / damageTakenPct — any other stat would be an invented mechanic.

it.skip + ⚑ — the 20.1% Shield-Coin branch OMITS the qualifier, implying it does heal, which would emit a recovery event and drive a teammate's on-recovery consumer (crown). Not modeled as a heal. Recipe: run rouge+crown and check whether crown's on-recovery buff refreshes on rouge's burst. If it does, this is a TANDEM damage line, not an inert one.

fixtures: controlComp('rouge', true) — liter B1 / crown B2 / rouge / helm B3, boss Fire, deterministic (no seed), 180s. rouge is Burst I so she casts every rotation while crown (B2) + helm (B3) still complete the chain, which every burst-keyed and full-burst-keyed assertion depends on; a fixture that stalled the chain would make them all vacuous. helm=true is kept deliberately: helm is the B3 closing the chain, and her buffs are read around by filtering buffApply events on casterSlug/stat rather than by removing her. Non-vacuity is asserted explicitly — burstCast count > 0, fullBurstStart count > 0, rouge shot count ≥ 30 (so both the 8-charge and 30-charge tiers are reachable), and the Shield-Coin buff appearing at least once (which is the precondition for the Double-Sword-Coin branch existing at all). Seven counterfactuals via withPatchedOverride, all mutating the SLOT-KEYED arrays (ov.skill1/ov.skill2/ov.burst): casterAtkPct→atkPct, attackDamagePct→atkPct, Sword-Coin target widened to allies, burst ATK deleted, all Max-HP grants deleted, all burstCdr deleted, damageTaken sign-flipped to an enemy debuff.
gaps: skill2 Sword Coin back-row gate — the engine's `formation` gate is noB1/hasB1 only; no row/position axis exists. Block authored as an unconditional passive under the stated assumption that the supporter is back row. No assertion can discriminate.

coin tier ladder (Sword Coin → Shield Coin → Double Sword Coin) — no SELF-status primitive; `targetStatus`/`requiresTargetStatus` is enemy-only by construction. Approximated by trigger-threshold ordering (passive / 30 full charges / 5 burst casts). Every gated payload is Max HP and therefore offensively inert, so the approximation moves ZERO damage — completeness gap, not a damage gap.

⚑ burst branch 3 (20.1%) omits the 'without restoring HP' qualifier that the other three Max-HP lines carry, implying it genuinely restores HP. Not modeled as a `heal`. This is the ONE gap that could be damage-relevant, via the TANDEM rule: a heal emits a recovery event that drives crown's 'when recovery takes effect' buff. Recipe: rouge+crown comp, check whether crown's on-recovery buff refreshes on rouge's burst cast; if yes, add `{kind:'heal'}` to that branch only.
